summary: The Acer Predator Helios 16 Neo, a high-performance gaming laptop, is experiencing a display issue with a persistent bright pixel and surrounding pixels.
detected_fault: A faulty or damaged pixel on the screen, possibly due to physical damage, pixel burn-in, or display panel defect.
suggested_solution: Contact Acer Support to confirm warranty status and schedule a repair or replacement, try calibrating the display settings, apply a screen protection film, or consider professional repair.
